---
description: chat_search as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  query: The names and words to look for.
  limit: The most messages to give.
  story: True to give only the messages that are part of the story. Leave it out to search every message.
---
Searches the whole chat. Each message found comes with its position, its id, who wrote it and the words around the match; one the chat's story choice leaves out of the story is marked.
